text: Barbara Shulman, Director of Strategic Recruitment, and Hali Farah, Senior HR Consultant, People and Equity Division will give a presentation on the City's strategy for increasing recruitment of people with disabilities.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. The Executive Committee request the Director, Strategic Recruitment to provide an update to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee in the second quarter 2020 that includes information on the specific recruitment tactics that will be used with the different disability communities.
